ruleDefinitions.name: NTDS.DIT Creation By Uncommon Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a file named "ntds.dit" (Active Directory Database) by an uncommon process or a process located in a suspicious directory

sequences.query: file_path = RGX("\\\\ntds\\\.dit$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wt\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*")))
